rows.note: Use 搵到 as the all-purpose everyday choice when you successfully locate something, including finding it for someone else.

example.english: I can find the book for you now.
example.traditional: 我而家可以幫你搵到本書喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ji4 gaa1 ho2 ji5 bong1 nei5 wan2 dou3 bun2 syu1 laa3

rows.note: Use 覺得 when “find” means forming an opinion or judging something to be a certain way.

example.english: I find this restaurant pretty good.
example.traditional: 我覺得呢間餐廳幾好食。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 ni1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 gei2 hou2 sik6

rows.note: Use 發現 when you discover something, whether by chance or through study or investigation.

example.english: I find out that this method does not work only after completing the experiment.
example.traditional: 我做完個實驗先發現原來呢個方法唔得。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zou6 jyun4 go3 sat6 jim6 sin1 faat3 jin6 jyun4 loi4 ni1 go3 fong1 faat3 m4 dak1
